answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the river check. Bindings are kept in saffron, verified in opal, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 22 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
